faq.q1: How do I start using the system?
faq.a1: Just register on our platform and choose the free plan to test the basic features.
faq.q2: Can I change my plan at any time?
faq.a2: Yes, you can switch to a higher or lower plan at any time. Changes will take effect from the next billing period.
faq.a3: We accept card payments, instant transfers, and recurring payments (subscriptions).
